mapper.select: SELECT USER_NO , USER_NAME , USER_ID , USER_PWD , USER_PHONE , USER_GRADE , USER_STATUS , UPDT_DATE , UPDT_ID , REG_DATE , REG_ID FROM user_info WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT USER_NO AS userNo, USER_ID AS userId, USER_NAME AS userName, USER_PHONE AS userPhone, USER_GRADE AS userGrade, USER_STATUS AS userStatus, REG_DATE AS regDate FROM user_info USER_NO = #{keyword}USER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')USER_PHONE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')USER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')AND REG_DATE >= CONCAT(#{registeredFrom}, ' 00:00:00')AND REG_DATE <= CONCAT(#{registeredTo}, ' 23:59:59')AND USER_GRADE IN #{item}AND USER_STATUS IN #{item} ORDER BY USER_NO DESC

SELECT USER_NO AS userNo, USER_ID AS userId, USER_NAME AS userName, USER_PHONE AS userPhone, USER_GRADE AS userGrade, USER_STATUS AS userStatus, REG_DATE AS regDate, REG_ID AS regId, UPDT_DATE AS updtDate, UPDT_ID AS updtId FROM user_info WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}
